subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In urban areas, air pollution levels have decreased significantly over the past two decades.
• Dr. Yun Dong and Dr. Navid Shirazi of Stanford University investigated whether pollution reduction is linked to changes in public health outcomes.
• Dong and Shirazi examined hospital admission records from metropolitan areas and compared respiratory illness rates with air quality measurements to determine if health improvements and pollution levels were correlated.
• Respiratory illness rates decreased during periods of improved air quality.
• Better air quality may have contributed to reduced respiratory health problems.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the aim of the research study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Thanks to the work done by Dr. Yun Dong and Dr. Navid Shirazi, we now know that better air quality may have contributed to reduced respiratory health problems.
choices.B: Dr. Yun Dong and Dr. Navid Shirazi, researchers at Stanford University, wanted to know if pollution reduction is linked to changes in public health outcomes.
choices.C: Stanford University researchers have determined that respiratory illness rates decreased during periods of improved air quality.
choices.D: Dr. Yun Dong and Dr. Navid Shirazi examined hospital admission records from metropolitan areas, comparing respiratory illness rates with air quality measurements.

explanation:
Choice B is correct. It emphasizes the research aim: Dong and Shirazi wanted to know if pollution reduction is linked to changes in public health outcomes.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. The sentence emphasizes the methodology of the study; it doesn't emphasize the aim.
